claims.description: Custom property declarations are accepted so application stylesheets can be parsed.

notes.text: Custom property declarations are accepted as inert declarations before value parsing.
CSS variable resolution is not implemented, so `var()` references in supported layout declarations remain unsupported.

claims.description: Transition declarations are accepted without affecting deterministic layout or hit testing.

notes.text: Transition declarations are accepted as inert declarations; animation timing and interpolated values are not modeled.
